note: Corrected from layer 3's 'Work permit (BIDA)': the Home Ministry's visa circular of 31 December 2019 gives foreign cultural performers and artists on contract their own visa category, P, issued on the inviting organisation's letter and its undertaking to pay the tax; a work permit or employment contract from the concerned authority is asked only to extend it. The Ministry of Cultural Affairs has in practice refused or granted permission for single shows (Nora Fatehi, 2022, trade press) but no published rule for it was found, so it isn't modelled. Visa fees are set by nationality, not in the circular.
